verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the sync server is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. Proton Pass documents no self-hosted server: its docs describe only Proton's hosted service, offline access to locally cached vaults, and a CLI. Community reports say only the clients are open source, not the server, and that there is no self-hosting option.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
